arxiv-1907-02780.title: Quantum heat engine with a quadratically coupled optomechanical system
arxiv-1907-02780.creator: M. Tahir Naseem, Özgür E. Müstecaplıoğlu
arxiv-1907-02780.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by M. Tahir Naseem, Özgür E. Müstecaplıoğlu. We propose a quantum heat engine based on a quadratically coupled optomechanical system. The optical component of the system is driven periodically with an incoherent thermal drive, which induces periodic oscillations in the mechanical component. Under the action of the quadratic optomechanical interaction, the mechanical mode evolves from an initial thermal state to a thermal-squeezed steady state, as verified by calculating the Wigner functions. The dynamics of the system is identified as an effective four-stroke Otto cycle.

arxiv-2106-14673.title: On the Garden of Eden theorem for ℬ \mathscr{B} -free subshifts
arxiv-2106-14673.creator: G. Keller, M. Lemańczyk, C. Richard, D. Sell
arxiv-2106-14673.description: Abstract We prove that on ℬ \mathscr{B} -free subshifts, with ℬ \mathscr{B} satisfying the Erdös condition, all cellular automata are determined by monotone sliding block codes. In particular, this implies the validity of the Garden of Eden theorem for such systems. 1 Introduction 1.

arxiv-2210-16233.title: On the Hausdorff dimension of invariant measures of piecewise smooth circle homeomorphisms
arxiv-2210-16233.creator: Frank Trujillo
arxiv-2210-16233.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Frank Trujillo. We show that, generically, the unique invariant measure of a sufficiently regular piecewise smooth circle homeomorphism with irrational rotation number and zero mean nonlinearity (e.g., piecewise linear) has zero Hausdorff dimension. To encode this generic condition, we consider piecewise smooth homeomorphisms as generalized interval exchange transformations (GIETs) of the interval and rely on the notion of combinatorial rotation number for GIETs, which can be seen as an extension of the classical notion of rotation number for circle homeomorphisms to the GIET setting.

arxiv-2211-11934.title: Real and virtual direct photon measurements with ALICE

arxiv-2211-11934.description: Abstract In this contribution the latest measurements of real and virtual photons in Pb–Pb collisions at s NN = 5.02 \sqrt{s_{\rm NN}}=5.02 TeV from the ALICE Collaboration are presented. The extracted photon spectra are compared to predictions from state-of-the-art models that explicitly include the whole evolution of the heavy-ion collision as well as measurements at lower energies.

uslaw-usc-t18-s3432.title: 18 U.S.C. § 3432 — Indictment and list of jurors and witnesses for prisoner in capital cases
uslaw-usc-t18-s3432.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s3432.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part II (Criminal Procedure); Chapter 221 (Arraignment, Pleas And Trial). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. A person charged with treason or other capital offense shall at least three entire days before commencement of trial, excluding intermediate weekends and holidays, be furnished with a copy of the indictment and a list of the veniremen.
